text_block_list.text:
Peeking into the dance studio, I saw 
Copano Rickey all alone, scratching her 
head in frustration.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer! You know what, I was 
wondering if I could incorporate feng shui 
into our dance choreography too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, I came up with an arranged 
choreography and proposed it to the 
teacher and everyone!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Everyone thinks it looks way too 
suspicious, though! There's nothing weird 
about it at all!
choice_data_list: Mind if I take a look?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty~! The theme is the Four Gods, who 
have deep ties to feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
First up is the Azure Dragon! Spin, spin, 
spiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next is Suzaku, the Vermilion Bird! 
*Squaaaawk*~!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Next, the White Tiger! Rawr rawr~!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And finally, Genbu! Crawl forward like a 
turtle! Kyuwa, kyuwa, kyuwa!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Something like that! How was it!?
choice_data_list: The white tiger was cute, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah!!
choice_data_list:
I thought the choreography looked a little 
suspicious overall…

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Eeeehhh~!? Even though it's a happy 
choreography that draws upon the power of 
the Four Gods!
choice_data_list:
How about narrowing down the key points 
for incorporating feng shui?

Isn't having fun dancing together the most 
important thing?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... that might have a point. Even 
with feng shui, taking it too far isn't 
good."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... I just wanted to make everyone 
happy, guess I got a little carried away!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the advice, Trainer!

Afterward, Copano Rickey created a new 
dance arrangement, and word is that 
everyone loved the choreography.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Having everyone be cheerful and 
having fun really is the most important 
thing."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Doing something you're not into won't make 
anyone happy. Forget the remix, let's 
dance with the original choreography!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's happiness is my happiness, 
after all! ☆

With that, Copano Rickey cheerfully 
resumed her dance practice.
